text: Laoshan Beer (崂山啤酒) is a brand of Tsingtao Brewery Co., Ltd.; the company describes Laoshan Beer as its 'national second brand' and as one of its own brands, and Tsingtao Brewery's Laoshan Beer is the sleeve-badge sponsor of Qingdao Hainiu's shirt.
short: Laoshan Beer is a Tsingtao Brewery brand.

source.name: Tsingtao Brewery Co., Ltd.: 2025 Annual Report summary (cninfo filing)
source.quote: 公司坚持“青岛啤酒主品牌+崂山啤酒全国性第二品牌”品牌战略
source.note: Translation: 'The Company adheres to the brand strategy of “Tsingtao Beer main brand + Laoshan Beer national second brand”.' 'The Company' is Tsingtao Brewery Co., Ltd. Quote checked in the PDF with pypdf.

additionalSources.name: Tsingtao Brewery official website (tsingtao.com.cn): 青岛啤酒品牌价值2803.55亿元，蝉联中国啤酒品牌榜首
additionalSources.quote: 青岛啤酒公司旗下的崂山啤酒（品牌价值776.35亿元）
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Tsingtao Brewery Company's own (旗下) Laoshan Beer (brand value RMB 77.635bn)'. From a company news post about the 2025 China 500 Most Valuable Brands list.

additionalSources.name: 网易 (NetEase, 易瞰青岛): 青岛信仰·青春力量 青岛海牛足球俱乐部2026赛季出征仪式圆满举行
additionalSources.quote: 青岛啤酒股份有限公司的崂山啤酒将继续为球队球衣的臂章广告
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'Tsingtao Brewery Co., Ltd.'s Laoshan Beer will continue as the sleeve-badge advertisement on the team's shirt.'
